claims: The February 2026 Producer Price Index (PPI) report showed a 0.7% rise in wholesale prices.
The 12-month PPI hit 3.4% according to the February 2026 PPI report.
The 12-month PPI of 3.4% was the highest since February 2025.
PPI for final demand rose 0.7% according to the February 2026 PPI report.
The forecast for the PPI monthly gain was 0.3%.
The 12-month PPI rise in January was 2.9%.
Core PPI rose 0.5% for the month.
Core PPI excludes food and energy.
The index for final demand goods jumped 1.1%.
The PPI measures the average change over time in the selling prices received by domestic producers for their output.
The headline PPI figure includes food and energy.
The next PPI report is scheduled to be released by the Bureau of Labor Statistics on April 15, 2026.
